sub_items.description: Lawsuit preamble and Israel/Mengele references (including embedded image of Bibi Netanyahu and point 19 regarding the moon landing)
Grievance alleging Candace accused Harpole of criminal negligence regarding ambulance absence
Grievance re: "Charlie's Angels or Demons" episode alleging implication of security team complicity
Grievance re: "The Great Exodus from Utah" episode alleging failure-to-render-aid via medical bag and lying about drone availability
Point 29 — assertion that Harpole is a private citizen and not a limited-purpose public figure
Point 28 — citation of Harpole's November 17 Sean Ryan appearance as defensive response to "Owens and other conspiracy theorists"
Point 50/59 — explanation that Harpole did not respond to Candace's texts to avoid giving her exclusive content
Points 54-55 — embedded text messages from Candace Owens to Brian Harpole
Point 63 — allegation that Candace's "Fort Huachuca confirmed" X post claimed proof that Snow was telling the truth about Harpole
Text: "Also, yes, I will say something about the security. I know them well."

First message: "Hi Brian, this is Candace Owens. A lot of people are telling me that you're planting seeds regarding a lawsuit. I wanted to see if you wanted to have an off-record discussion with me about anything or if you'd like to simply clarify something that you think that I got wrong."
Second message (Dec 19 follow-up): "Hi Brian, just again reaching out in case you want to clarify your whereabouts on the morning of September 9th. I'm only interested in the truth."
Third message: "Hey Brian, reaching out again to see if you'd be willing to speak about the morning of the 9th... I oddly cannot get you to confirm or deny if you were there."

Audio: "I know there's a lot of conspiracy theories floating in about the security guard and people thinking he was making gestures. I know that security person. He's a good guy... I don't I don't buy that one, okay? I don't buy that one."
Initial text regarding Sorensen Center rooftop access
Chief Long reply: "I got you covered."

X post text: "Find your favorite podcaster who joined the psychological operation to convince you that Mitch was lying about having been at Fort Huachuca... I always believed Mitch's story... What we cannot confirm as of yet is his memory of who he is convinced he saw coming out of that early morning meeting."

Audio: "Number one, why did you claim Candace said that Erika killed Charlie. She's never said it that I've seen... Talked to Candace, I've never heard her say that... No one who's ever been on this show has ever said that."
Audio discussing myths regarding Mengele's twin transfusions and the "sewing twins together" legend
Times of Israel headline: "US House is considering a resolution condemning Hasan [Piker] and Candace Owens for anti-Semitism"

Resolution passages: "Whereas Candace Owens has employed rhetoric that has included conspiracy theories accusing Israel of controlling the United States government... Government promoting false claims that Jews are taught by ancient religious texts to hate non-Jews... she made the anti-Semitic claim that the United States is controlled by satanic pedophiles who work for Israel... she repeated false claims that Jews are killing Christian children."

Audio: "This political violence stems from a systemic demonization of him and his supporters by commentators... deranged lies and smears against the president, his family, his supporters have led crazy people to believe crazy things."

Post: "His monologue about my family is not comedy. His words are corrosive and deepens the political sickness within America. People like Kimmel shouldn't have the opportunity to enter our homes each evening to spread hate."
Post: "Hate speech does not exist legally in America. There's ugly speech, there's gross speech, there's evil speech, and all of it is protected by the First Amendment. Keep America free."

Audio: "I spent thousands of dollars on drones last year... if the area lies in the Provo, Utah airspace, I can't fly. That's a 107B... we can't break the rules... on our way in, we had drone footage of the crowd building... I said, Charlie, I don't like this place. There are too many buildings."
Selected comments including Michael Jester's note about malicious-prosecution exposure for SLAPP suits and Jen Common's note on UVU drone authorization form

claims.label: Harpole Filed 69-Page Defamation Lawsuit Against Candace Owens
claims.claim: Brian Harpole filed a 69-page civil complaint against Candace Owens asserting multiple defamation claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed complaint and PACER docket to verify the exact count and nature of causes of action.

claims.label: Pre-Filing Email Announced Lawsuit Would Proceed Regardless of Retraction
claims.claim: Harpole's counsel sent an email styled as a retraction demand but stated at the outset that the lawsuit would be filed in four days regardless.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the pre-filing email; verify whether it contained a formal retraction request.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges Candace Accused Harpole of Criminal Negligence Regarding Ambulance
claims.claim: The lawsuit's first grievance alleges Candace accused Harpole and his team of criminal negligence by failing to have an ambulance on standby and failing to render aid after Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the quoted podcast passage against the actual transcript to verify Candace's exact words.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges "Charlie's Angels or Demons" Episode Implied Security Team Had Insider Knowledge
claims.claim: The lawsuit alleges Candace's episode implied Harpole's security team had foreknowledge of and complicity in Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and review the "Charlie's Angels or Demons" episode to verify whether Harpole was named and to identify the actual subjects of the commentary.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges Candace Falsely Accused Harpole of Failing to Render Aid via Medical Bag and Lying About Drone Availability
claims.claim: The lawsuit alleges Candace accused Harpole of failing to render effective aid with his medical bag and of lying about drone availability.
claims.investigative_direction: Review "The Great Exodus from Utah" episode transcript; compare Candace's exact statements to the lawsuit's quoted passages.

claims.label: Lawsuit Asserts Harpole Is a Private Citizen
claims.claim: The lawsuit's point 29 asserts Harpole is a private individual, not a limited-purpose public figure, despite two podcast appearances.
claims.investigative_direction: Review defamation caselaw on limited-purpose public figure doctrine and assess Harpole's voluntary insertion into the controversy.

claims.label: Lawsuit Cites November 17 Sean Ryan Appearance as Defensive Response
claims.claim: Point 28 of the lawsuit asserts Harpole appeared on Sean Ryan "solely to respond to and to rebut the defamatory statements" by Candace and other conspiracy theorists.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the air date of Harpole's Sean Ryan appearance and the prior existence (or absence) of Candace's commentary naming Harpole.

claims.label: Candace First Mentioned Harpole by Name on November 19, Two Days After His Sean Ryan Appearance
claims.claim: Candace states she never once mentioned Harpole on her podcast prior to his November 17 Sean Ryan appearance; her first mention was November 19.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior episode transcripts and show notes for any reference to him prior to November 19.

claims.label: Candace Sent Three Unanswered Text Messages to Harpole Before the Mitch Snow Interview
claims.claim: Candace sent Harpole three text messages seeking clarification of his whereabouts on September 9; Harpole did not reply to any of them.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the embedded text messages against phone records; verify Harpole's receipt.

claims.label: Lawsuit Claims Harpole's Non-Response Was Intended to Avoid Giving Candace Exclusive Content
claims.claim: The lawsuit explains Harpole's non-response to Candace's text messages as a refusal to provide her exclusive yes-or-no content for viewership profit.
claims.investigative_direction: Assess credibility of this litigation rationale against the timing (December to April delay) and the lawsuit-filing posture.

claims.label: Candace Publicly Defended Harpole and the TPUSA Security Team Against Hand-Signal Conspiracies in September
claims.claim: Candace texted Andrew Kolvet agreeing to defend the security team and issued a same-day podcast statement defending Harpole and Dan Flood.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the September 2025 episode in which Candace defended the security team.

claims.label: Lawsuit Admits the Rooftop Text Chain Was Between Dan Flood and Chief Long, Not Harpole
claims.claim: Although Harpole presented the Sorensen Center rooftop text chain on Sean Ryan as his own, the lawsuit admits the messages were between Dan Flood and UVU Police Chief Long.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the original Sean Ryan audio against the lawsuit's admission to identify the precise point of misrepresentation.

claims.label: Candace's December 23 X Post Confirmed Fort Huachuca but Did Not Confirm Snow's Identification of Harpole
claims.claim: Candace's December 23 X post stated Fort Huachuca was confirmed via metadata and incident report but explicitly stated the team could not confirm Snow's identification of who he saw.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original X post screenshot and verify text against the quoted excerpt.

claims.label: Lawsuit Simultaneously Accuses Candace of Confirming Snow's Claim While Including Her Explicit Non-Confirmation
claims.claim: Point 63 of the lawsuit accuses Candace of asserting proof that Snow was telling the truth about Harpole, even while the lawsuit's own exhibits include Candace's statement that she could not confirm the identification.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific X post passages cited by the lawsuit to determine whether the allegation is supported by context.

claims.label: Harpole's Drone Statement Conflicts with Frank Turek's Account
claims.claim: Harpole's statement that drones could not be flown in Provo airspace conflicts with Frank Turek's separate account of flying drones at UVU events.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full audio of Turek's drone statements and cross-reference with FAA Part 107 rules for Provo airspace.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Publicly Claimed Candace Accused Her of Killing Charlie
claims.claim: Erika Kirk publicly asserted that Candace accused her of murdering Charlie Kirk; the statement was widely discussed.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Erika Kirk's original statement on video or social media to verify exact wording and context.

claims.label: Candace States She Does Not Believe Erika Kirk Murdered Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Candace asserts she has never publicly accused Erika Kirk of murdering Charlie and explicitly disclaims that belief.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior podcast transcripts and X posts for any statement that could be construed as accusing Erika.

claims.label: Baron Coleman Questioned Erika's Claim That Candace Had Accused Her
claims.claim: Baron Coleman stated on his show that he had never heard Candace say Erika killed Charlie and questioned why Erika made the claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Coleman's full segment for additional context.

claims.label: Lawler and Gottheimer Introduced Bipartisan House Resolution Condemning Candace Owens
claims.claim: Reps. Mike Lawler (R-NY) and Josh Gottheimer (D-NJ) introduced a bipartisan House resolution condemning Candace Owens, among others.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full resolution text from Congress.gov and verify resolution number, co-sponsors, and referral.

claims.label: Resolution Alleges Candace Accused Israel of Controlling the United States Government
claims.claim: The resolution text characterizes Candace's rhetoric as accusing Israel of controlling the US government.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior commentary for any statement matching the resolution's characterization.

claims.label: Resolution Alleges Candace Claimed Satanic Pedophiles Work for Israel
claims.claim: The resolution text asserts Candace made an anti-Semitic claim that the United States is controlled by satanic pedophiles who work for Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Candace's commentary on Epstein, Israeli intelligence, and pedophilia rings for the exact phrasing.

claims.label: Resolution References Candace's Josef Mengele Commentary
claims.claim: The resolution text references Candace's July 2024 commentary regarding Josef Mengele and "bizarre propaganda" following the Holocaust.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Candace's July 2024 statements about Mengele and verify exact wording.

claims.label: Auschwitz Memorial Podcast Acknowledged Myths About Mengele's Twin Experiments
claims.claim: The official Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial podcast acknowledged that myths arose around Mengele, including the "sewing twins together" legend that did not occur.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Auschwitz Memorial podcast episode for full context.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's May 2, 2024 Tweet Denied the Legal Existence of Hate Speech
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk wrote on May 2, 2024 that "Hate speech does not exist legally in America."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post's date, persistence, and any replies or context.
